fr.campus.dungeoncrawler.character.enemy.Enemy
fr.campus.dungeoncrawler.character.enemy.Goblin
public class Goblin extends Enemy
Class representing the Goblin enemy in the Dungeon Crawler game. This class extends the Enemy class and provides specific attributes and behaviors for the Goblin.
